Container.Name: Tandem
Container.Overview: Tandem is a self-hosted co-parenting app: a shared parenting-time calendar with swap requests both parents must accept, permanent tamper-evident messages with read receipts, shared expenses with automatic splits, school and district calendar subscriptions (iCal/RSS) with days off flagged, a child profile with insurance cards and care team, a document library for the parenting plan and records, optional voice calls between parents with recording when both agree, an exchange log, a private journal, and printable court-ready reports. Installs on iPhone and Android from the browser like a native app. All data lives in /data (one SQLite file plus uploaded files).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: coparenting co-parenting custody parenting schedule calendar family calls
Container.Requires: For installing on phones and for push-style updates, put Tandem behind HTTPS (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, or Cloudflare Tunnel) and set PUBLIC_URL and TRUST_PROXY.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web app. Change the host side only if 4380 is already used.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds tandem.db (all accounts, schedules, messages, expenses) and files/ (uploaded documents and card photos). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use to reach Tandem, e.g. https://tandem.example.com. Used to build invite links. When it starts with https://, secure cookies turn on automatically. Leave blank for LAN-only use.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Default time zone for new families and server logs (IANA name). Each family can change its own time zone in the app.

Config.Name: Allow open sign-ups
Config.Description: false (recommended): the first person to open Tandem creates the first family; everyone after that needs an invite link. true: anyone who can reach the server can create their own family.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files in Data. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files in Data. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for new files in Data. 022 lets only the owner write; 002 also lets the group write.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when Tandem sits behind a reverse proxy, so sign-in rate limiting uses the real visitor IP from X-Forwarded-For.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Blank = automatic (on when PUBLIC_URL is https). Force with true or false.

Config.Name: Session length (days)
Config.Description: How long a device stays signed in.

Config.Name: App name
Config.Description: Name shown on the sign-in screen and in reports.

Config.Name: Log requests
Config.Description: true writes one line per request to the container log. Useful for troubleshooting.

Config.Name: School calendar refresh (hours)
Config.Description: How often linked school and district calendars are downloaded again. 0 turns background refresh off; parents can still refresh a calendar from the app.

Config.Name: Allow calendar links on private networks
Config.Description: false (recommended) refuses school calendar links that point at private addresses like 192.168.x.x or localhost, so a link can't be used to probe your network. Set true only if you host a calendar file on your own LAN.

Config.Name: Weather provider
Config.Description: auto: US National Weather Service for US locations, Open-Meteo elsewhere. nws: US only, free, includes severe-weather alerts. openmeteo: worldwide, free for non-commercial use. off: no weather.

Config.Name: Weather units
Config.Description: Temperatures in fahrenheit or celsius.

Config.Name: ZIP code table (optional)
Config.Description: Optional file that turns ZIP codes into locations on your server instead of using Open-Meteo's geocoding. Accepts the Census ZCTA gazetteer file or a zip,lat,lon CSV in your appdata folder.

Config.Name: Receipt reader URL (optional)
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API with a vision model, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or a local Ollama server like http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1. Leave blank to turn receipt reading off; receipts can still be attached.

Config.Name: Receipt reader model
Config.Description: Vision model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, or a local model like qwen2.5vl or llama3.2-vision.

Config.Name: Receipt reader API key
Config.Description: API key for the receipt reader, if it needs one. Local servers usually don't.

Config.Name: Call server address (optional)
Config.Description: Voice calls between parents use a LiveKit server. Address phones use to reach it, e.g. wss://calls.example.com. Blank turns calls off. The easiest way to run LiveKit and recording is the calls add-on: install Tandem with Docker Compose and run ./setup.sh (see the README).

Config.Name: Call server API address
Config.Description: Where Tandem reaches the LiveKit server API, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7880. Blank = the same host as the call server address.

Config.Name: Call server API key
Config.Description: LiveKit API key.

Config.Name: Call server API secret
Config.Description: LiveKit API secret (at least 32 characters). Keep it private.

Config.Name: Call recordings folder
Config.Description: Folder inside the container where LiveKit Egress leaves finished recordings. Tandem copies each one into Data with a fingerprint, then removes it. Map a host folder here only if you run Egress yourself.
